definition_used: An investigation by the journal/publisher of the article.
caution: This reason indicates an investigation process by the journal/publisher, not the underlying cause. It is a procedural metadata signal and does not specify what content or conduct issue triggered the investigation. Therefore, it maps only to post-publication oversight and not to content or authorship categories without further evidence.
semantic_rationale: The definition describes a journal/publisher-led investigation, which is a post-publication oversight process. It does not inherently indicate problems with research content, authorship, or editorial governance, so only the post_publication_transparency_due_process_oversight category is assigned.
